items.title: Banquet & Awards Ceremony
items.venue: The Light Box, Quorum Business Park, Benton Ln, Newcastle upon Tyne NE12 8BT
items.description: Join us for a special afternoon of celebration, recognition, and gratitude as we reflect on a year of impact at Joybringers. This elegant Banquet & Awards Night will honour outstanding volunteers, young achievers, partners, and community supporters who have made a difference throughout the year. Dress code: Corporate / Black Tie.

items.title: 6-Week R-Programming coding Bootcamp (Every Saturday)
items.venue: Suite 3, Neon, Quorum Business Park, NE12 8BU
items.description: A 6-week beginner-friendly R-Programming coding bootcamp designed to build confidence and real digital skills. Each Saturday includes hands-on learning, fun challenges, and guided support from our team. Suitable for young people and anyone ready to learn step-by-step. Please come with a laptop if possible.

items.title: Volunteer Hangout
items.description: A Day set aside for volunteers to come together, have fun and network

items.title: ParentConnect Online Programme
items.description: ParentConnect is a supportive online programme for mums, dads, single parents, and carers of all backgrounds. This session will provide practical discussions, helpful tips, and real conversations about supporting children, strengthening families, and helping young people grow in confidence.

items.title: Family Picnic
items.description: A relaxed family day out filled with games, laughter, and good company. Bring your picnic items and a change of clothes for water splash play, take part in fun outdoor activities, and connect with other families in the community. Suitable for all ages, this is a wonderful opportunity to build friendships, create memories, and enjoy the summer together.

items.title: Explore Sunderland: Excursion to Mowbray Park
items.description: Join us for a fun excursion to Sunderland for a day of sightseeing, bonding, and exploring together. We'll spend time at Mowbray Park and enjoy a mix of relaxation and group activities. Perfect for families and young people who want a safe, friendly, and memorable day out.

items.title: Pizza & Wrap Workshop
items.venue: Suite 3, Neon, Quorum Business Park, NE12 8BU
items.description: A hands-on food workshop where participants will learn how to prepare simple pizzas and wraps. We'll cover basic kitchen skills, healthy choices, and safe food handling in a friendly environment. Great for young people and families. Please inform us of any allergies or dietary needs during registration.

items.title: Photography & Video Editing Training (Free)
items.venue: The Light Box, Quorum Business Park, Benton Ln, Newcastle upon Tyne NE12 8BT
items.description: A free, practical training session covering the essentials of photography and video production. You will learn how to handle a camera, frame and shoot clean photos, capture smooth video footage, set up sound equipment, and edit your content. All equipment provided. Suitable for ages 14 and above. No prior experience needed.
items.preEventInfo: Please bring camera or its accesories only if you have

items.title: Multi-Skilled Workshop (Ages 7-15, 16-25)
items.venue: Suite 3, Neon, Quorum Business Park, NE12 8BU
items.description: A practical skills day featuring a mix of creative and self-care activities including knitting, crocheting, nails, make-up, and art. Participants will rotate through mini sessions and learn simple techniques they can continue at home. A supportive space to build confidence, discover talents, and connect with others.

items.title: Fruit Kebabs Workshop (Healthy Snacks Session) for ALL ages
items.venue: Suite 3, Neon, Quorum Business Park, NE12 8BU
items.description: A fun, hands-on healthy snacks session led by Donna Robinson from ASDA. Young people will learn basic food preparation skills and create colourful fruit kebabs while exploring healthy eating tips in a friendly and supportive environment. Please inform us of any food allergies during registration.

items.description: Hands-on data analytics training for ages 16-25. Laptop with Excel and Power BI required.
